payload.claim: `_path_tokens` treats any backtick-quoted word containing '/' and not ending in '/' as a repo-relative path to check against `touches`, but it strips no trailing annotation. This repo's own specs routinely cite files as `path/to/file.py:123` (e.g. SA-0005, SA-0007, SA-0008, SA-0010, SA-0011, SA-0012 all use this convention elsewhere in their prose) — if such a citation ever appears inside an '## Acceptance criteria' bullet instead of Context/Notes, the extracted token 'path/to/file.py:123' will never equal any `touches` glob via `scope.matches` (which requires the whole string to match), so `_unmatched_criterion_path` refuses a spec whose named file is in fact touched. None of the new fixtures in tests/test_scheduler.py exercise a line-numbered citation, so this false-positive class passes every test while remaining live against real spec-authoring style in this repo.
